svg.text: Private Web Search Agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Terraform)
TechEventsFinder agent on AgentCore Runtime inside a VPC with no internet gateway and no NAT gateway. Model and Web Search tool reached only through AWS PrivateLink interface endpoints.
VPC (no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, no public IPs)
free, scoped to the ECR layer bucket
served inside AWS, no API keys
via route table and S3 prefix list
InvokeAgentRuntime (SigV4) from an operator or CI host to the AgentCore Runtime data plane
Runtime reaches the agent container over its managed data path; the agent's ENIs sit in the private subnets
Reasoning path: Bedrock InvokeModel through the bedrock-runtime endpoint (policy allows InvokeModel* for the runtime role only)
Tool path: MCP to the Gateway URL, resolved by private DNS to the gateway endpoint; SigV4 with the execution role, endpoint policy scopes Principal and Resource
The Gateway uses its own service role to call the AWS-managed Web Search target
Startup: image manifest pulled through the ecr.api and ecr.dkr interface endpoints
Startup: image layers pulled from the Regional S3 bucket through the free S3 gateway endpoint (runtime SG egress to the S3 prefix list)
Observability: vended application logs and ADOT spans to CloudWatch Logs, TRACES delivery to X-Ray Transaction Search (GenAI Observability)
bedrock-agentcore data-plane endpoint: data-plane tokens, and optional private InvokeAgentRuntime from a host inside the VPC
